Domain engineering | Domain engineering, also called product line engineering, is the entire process of reusing domain knowledge in the production of new software systems.  It is a key concept in systematic software reuse.  A key idea in systematic software reuse is the domain.  Most organizations work in only a few domains.  They repeatedly build similar systems within a given domain with variations to meet different customer needs.
